body.zh: NDRRMA 11:37UTC仅为人员调任祝贺，未列Bhotekoshi伤亡。SitRep 2280仍无新分项。中方指挥部仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。应急管理部9月17日合计562人死亡失踪，与分项一致。堰塞湖已排空。口岸关闭。勿与中方相加。
body.en: NDRRMA 11:37 UTC was a staff-transfer note only; no Bhotekoshi casualties. SitRep 2280 still has no new split. CN command centre remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. MEM 17 Sep combined 562 dead/missing matches that split. Lake drained. Gate closed. Do not add CN.
body.ne: NDRRMA 11:37 UTC saruwa matra. SitRep 2280 ma naya split chaina. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 milcha. Tal khali. Gate band. CN najodnu.
body.hi: NDRRMA 11:37 UTC transfer matra. SitRep 2280 mein naya split nahi. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. MEM 17 Sep 562 milta hai. Jheel khali. Gate band. CN na joden.
